title: How To Hide Top-Level Category From Member's Profile Page
text:
## How To Hide Top-Level Category From Member's Profile Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000084651
In order to hide the top-level category from the member's profile page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12102900541/original/OvIM0YD9o9hwc3Hili9EYhnCdFQo3R5nOA.png?1640704726 | alt: ]
Navigate to Settings - Advanced Settings and search for " Hide Top-Level Category on Member Profile Page ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647340/original/Duma6JkfVp337FWmq5CeVR_SkfwdDEkFCQ.png?1753161158 | alt: ]
When this advanced setting is enabled, the top-level category that displays on the member profile under the name is removed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12102901513/original/Ztr53MWOd-PONUax8AnlTlR-tqMd1SAFUg.png?1640705912 | alt: ]
